g_policy.reason: The banner is opt-in, the offer copy states the reward (30 minutes with no ads), declining hides the banner while the app works as before, and 'if the ad fails' covers a missing game or an unconfirmed play.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 30 minutes of ad-free use, a feature_time reward with no cash value.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is session time plus a loaded playable on s01, which are app events. No chat content is involved.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The idea adds a temporary ad-free window and removes, locks or caps nothing users get free today ('removes nothing free: yes').

g_brand_safety.reason: The banner sits as app chrome on s01 Home, which is rated safe, and it is not in a conversation or next to unsafe or unknown content.

c1_revealed_value.reason: As a product change, the new ad-free time is something the player uses for themselves while reading stories and browsing the feed (f01, f02), and none of the reward goes to other people.

c2_evidence.reason: 'The app shows ads' is supported by m01 (native sponsored card in the feed). The revenue remark is a prediction, and the banner, window and copy are what the proposal itself adds.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: No paid plan was observed. The reward expires after 30 minutes, is capped at 2 per day, and takes nothing from other users or creators.

c5_moment.reason: The dismissible banner sits on the s01 Home feed and does not block the user or interrupt an article in progress. Session length and a ready playable are app-detectable conditions.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn playable. The reward is granted only when the play is confirmed ('if the play is not confirmed, nothing changes'), and the trigger is a detectable app event.

c7_specific.reason: The 'what makes it work here' field says only 'The app shows ads' and would read the same in any ad-supported app. It names no specific element of this app, such as the home-feed native ad slot (m01), and cites no evidence.

other_concern: The feed ad slot is sometimes empty and its network varies (open question), so the ad-free reward may be worth little in some sessions. The scope of 'hide ads in the app' is also not defined, for example whether it covers in-article Taboola units.
